title: Job Search Task
description: Run a focused, repeatable search for current vacancies across multiple legitimate sources using your own role, location and job criteria.
audience: Job seekers who want a structured recurring search across job portals and employer career pages
useCases: find roles across multiple job sources
filter vacancies by work arrangement and employment type
repeat a consistent job search over time

fields.label: Keywords
fields.placeholder: API, digital banking, product, requirements, integration

howToUse: Enter your target role and location, then add any useful filters such as work arrangement, employment type, salary, keywords or exclusions.
Copy the completed prompt and open ChatGPT.
Run the prompt when you want a fresh vacancy search so the results reflect current listings.
Personally review each vacancy and employer before deciding whether to apply.
prompt:
MASTER PROMPT — RECURRING JOB SEARCH

Act as my job-search research assistant.

Search for current job vacancies matching the criteria below.

TARGET ROLE:
{{targetRole}}

LOCATION:
{{location}}

{{#if workArrangement}}WORK ARRANGEMENT:
{{workArrangement}}

{{/if}}{{#if employmentType}}EMPLOYMENT TYPE:
{{employmentType}}

{{/if}}{{#if salaryTarget}}SALARY TARGET:
{{salaryTarget}}

{{/if}}{{#if keywords}}IMPORTANT KEYWORDS:
{{keywords}}

{{/if}}{{#if exclude}}EXCLUDE:
{{exclude}}

{{/if}}Search broadly across relevant sources, including:
- major job portals
- company careers websites
- direct employer vacancy pages
- other legitimate public job listings

Do not rely only on one job platform.

Prioritise roles that genuinely match the criteria.

For every suitable vacancy, provide:
- Job Title
- Company
- Location
- Work arrangement if stated
- Employment type if stated
- Salary if publicly stated
- Why it appears relevant
- Direct application / vacancy link

Do not invent missing information.

If salary, working arrangement or other details are not stated, write:
"Not stated."

Avoid duplicate vacancies already included in previous results where possible.

Only surface legitimate vacancies that appear active at the time of checking.

Keep the output concise and easy to scan.

I will personally review each vacancy and decide whether to apply.
